company.description: rct AI develops artificial intelligence technologies and tools for gaming and interactive entertainment. The company focuses on AI-generated content that powers intelligent non-player characters, dynamic storylines, and adaptive virtual worlds. Its cloud-based Chaos Box platform enables developers to create self-evolving virtual environments, creatures, and NPCs with real-time AI control. rct AI also creates games such as The Extractors, which showcase AI-driven NPC behavior and narrative generation. The company applies deep learning, reinforcement learning, natural language processing, and computer vision to build AI agent systems that support natural interaction between players and virtual characters.
